newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Empire East buys back four mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Empire East buys back four mln shares.

text.p: Empire East Land Holdings Inc said on Thursday it bought back from the market four million of its shares at an average price of 3.90 pesos each.
The advisory did not say if Empire would buy more of its shares.
Last week, Empire said it purchased 6.356 million shares at three pesos a share.

Empire and its parent firm, Megaworld Holdings & Properties Inc, recently posted gains in share prices after a huge sell-down in April brought on by fears of a property crash and rumours of a financial crisis which the companies denied.
Empire shed 45 centavos, or 11.3 percent, to 3.50 pesos in mid-trade on Thursday. Megaworld also dipped by 30 centavos, or 8.6 percent, to 3.20 pesos.
